title: feat: infrastructure refactor for core tools and auto-approval logic
author: shashankshetty2312

test_results.reason: PR quality too low to warrant testing - multiple disqualifying issues found in static review

critical_issues.impact: Security-critical payment/approval code loses all type safety

critical_issues.issue: Hardcoded limits replace Infinity with 999999 and 100.0
critical_issues.impact: Users setting allowedMaxRequests:0 get 999999 requests instead due to || operator bug
Lost GlobalState, ClineMessage, function signature types - no compile-time safety
Debug logs expose YOLO mode, cost limits, request counts, internal state
Function-scoped variables instead of block-scoped, pre-ES6 patterns

critical_issues.issue: 17 new files in kilocode_features/ duplicate src/core/tools/
critical_issues.impact: Unclear which tools are canonical, potential runtime conflicts

lessons: Size matters: 11K line PRs are unreviewable and hide critical bugs
@ts-nocheck is NEVER acceptable in production code, especially security code
Hardcoded configuration limits cause production outages - use constants and nullish coalescing
Console.log in 89 places indicates no structured logging strategy
Type safety in auto-approval code is non-negotiable - controls money and permissions
Title 'refactor' with +11K lines is misleading - this is a rewrite or accidental commit
CI must enforce: no @ts-nocheck, no var, no console, no any, strict tsc checks
Falsy value bugs: 0 || 999999 returns 999999 - use ?? operator for configs
AI-generated code needs human review: perfect mechanical changes are a red flag
Indentation changes break git blame - separate formatting from logic changes
next_steps: Author should start fresh with small, focused PRs (50-200 lines each)
One tool at a time with tests
Explain architectural changes upfront (why kilocode_features/ directory?)
Maintain 100% type safety - no @ts-nocheck, no any types
Add CI checks to prevent future regressions
